Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the very first analysis step. After the WebSurfer correctly identified Anastasia of Serbia's husband as Stefan Nemanja (who ruled 1166–1196 and died in 1199), the Planner incorrectly stated that the husband was "Stefan Prvovenčani, who ruled from 1196 to 1228." This is a confusion between Stefan Nemanja (father) and Stefan the First-Crowned (son). Stefan Prvovenčani was not Anastasia's husband; he was her son. Consequently, the entire subsequent search process was based on the wrong person, leading to the incorrect conclusion that the place of death was Studenica Monastery (Stefan Prvovenčani's death/burial site) instead of the correct answer, Hilandar (Stefan Nemanja's death site).
